title: Integrated Branch Network Troubleshooting Challenge
summary: Diagnose and resolve multi-domain branch office faults spanning 802.1Q trunk allowed-VLAN pruning, IP helper forwarding, static return routing, and perimeter access control lists in a multi-tier Cisco IOS environment.
learning_objectives: Isolate and resolve 802.1Q trunk allowed-VLAN pruning misconfigurations that drop inter-VLAN traffic
Verify and repair Cisco IOS IP helper-address configuration across router boundaries
Diagnose and correct asymmetric or mispointed static return routes that blackhole enterprise traffic
Analyze and refine extended access control lists to eliminate unintended packet filtering
Verify complete bidirectional connectivity across multi-domain branch networks

source.origin: Independently authored comprehensive multi-domain branch network troubleshooting challenge integrating VLAN trunking, DHCP helper services, routing, and security policies
